import java.util.*;
public class Redactor { public static Map<String,String> redact(Map<String,String> input){var out=new LinkedHashMap<String,String>();input.forEach((k,v)->out.put(k,Set.of("password","token","api_key").contains(k.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))?"***":v));return out;} }
